title: gyro.json
description: The gyroscope samples of one attempt, schema version 1 (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §11, T3.7): from 2 s before its first scramble turn to 1 s after its end, as the cube reported them. Sample k is at host time t0HostMs + dtMs[0] + … + dtMs[k]; its quaternion is q[4k..4k+3] (x, y, z, w) and its velocity v[3k..3k+2]. The cube's frame is right-handed, +X through the red face, +Y through the blue face, +Z through the white face; the yaw has an arbitrary reference and drifts.

session.description: The id of the session: a lowercase UUID v4.

index.description: The attempt's 1-based position in its session.

app.description: The build that wrote the file.

t0HostMs.description: The host time of the first sample.

dtMs.description: Per sample, the time since the previous one, in steps of 0.1 ms (the differences of the sample times rounded to 0.1 ms, as the frames files keep them); 0 for the first.

q.description: Unit quaternions, flat, four per sample (x, y, z, w), as the cube reports them, to 5 decimals.

v.description: The angular velocity's raw integers, flat, three per sample (a Gen2 cube's are 4-bit signed values, −7 to 7); null when the cube gives none.

truncatedStart.description: The buffer did not reach back to the window's start: the file begins at its oldest sample.

app.description: The build of the app that wrote the file: the version of the root package.json and the short SHA of its commit (session.json has had it since version 1; the other files since T3.7, so those written before have none).

commit.description: Short SHA of the build's commit.
